title: Centuria
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Julian, a young man enslaved on a ship, is the only survivor when it sinks, and receives the lives and powers of a hundred people from a mysterious being (to verify). He takes in an infant, Diana, born on the ship, and raises her as he fights through a medieval world of kings, gods and prophecy (to verify).
life_message: It holds up protecting the vulnerable and building a chosen family out of loss.

content.note: Slavery, mass death at sea and brutal battles flagged (to verify; Gore signal, AniList Tragedy, Slavery; likely higher).

Julian, 'sold into slavery by his own mother', has 'known nothing but pain and brutality' in 'a cruel and violent world' (Viz description); ANN's Winter 2026 Manga Guide (T+) calls it brutal, citing a woman giving herself a C-section with an old knife to save her baby and 'Junji Ito-style fish monsters', though it 'never loses its heart'.
MangaDex suggestive; nothing specific known (to verify).

dominant: Communitarianism (found family), Classical virtue ethics, Critical theory (slavery)
